clause: DESIGN R3.3 §8.3 L649-L659 surfaces and fields; §6.2 L468 validation records author disabled checks
derivation: Vendored neutral profile with version 1.6.0, the lot-5 base/descriptor pins, the aid body field, five synthetic notions, seventeen added recipes (twenty-seven in total, delete-lane included), two glyphs, twenty-one UI entries over all eight surfaces (lane-delete included) and five messages. Its ten validation records set every one of the 26 standard bpmnlint settings to off (a disabled check authored in profile data, DESIGN L468; identical in draft and accept, so not a draft downgrade of an integrity rule, L481) and keep the five profile subrules task-named* unchanged (warn in draft, error in accept). Reason: the vendored descriptor slice admits no FlowNode incoming/outgoing reference and no EndEvent, so bpmnlint no-disconnected, no-implicit-start and no-implicit-end (error, integrity) flag every Task of every lot-5 document; the vendored validation records are exercised by fixture-profile-neutral-lint and the lint-draft-* witnesses. profileSha256 = H(composed profile); the committed profile bytes (expected.artifact) are its profile-c14n/2 bytes.
author: spec-seal
